title: bromus tomentellus var. sclerophyllus
intro: Bromus tomentellus var. sclerophyllus, commonly known as Sclerophyllous Brome, is a plant species within the grass family (Poaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Sclerophyllous Brome include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
